name: @withmarfa/sync-manifest
description: The manifest the sync client installs against. Sync is a client: it watches a filesystem, so its code runs on the user's machine as the daemon in the withmarfa/sync repo (npm: @withmarfa/sync). Installing it as a connection is how it gets credentials, configuration and observability; this package is the declaration that makes that possible, shipped with the server build rather than installed into an integrations directory.
